notes: Pinned proper-day fixture (Core #81/#87). Each row is a fixed-date proper feast the FSSP calendar publishes at an elevated class, pinned to a specific civil year in which the feast is actually celebrated (not impeded by a privileged temporal day), with the class the Fraternity assigns it. The FSSP District of England & Wales states the Chair of St Peter (22 Feb) is a feast of the FIRST class in FSSP apostolates (universal: second class). Uncopyrightable calendar facts only; Latin titles are not stored here (the overlay only re-ranks existing universal feasts). A NON-EXHAUSTIVE, well-attested subset — not the Fraternity's complete promulgated Proprium.

fields.date: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — the specific year the proper day is checked in
fields.id: the universal ObservanceId the FSSP calendar elevates
fields.name: readable English name (not compared)
fields.class: the liturgical class the FSSP calendar assigns (1 = first class)
fields.source: the registered corpus source key backing the fact
